{{Top|leg}}
An '''Emnat suit''' was a type of uniform that contained self-sealing properties against cuts and punctures. It was utilized by most officials of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]] utilized a self-sealing mechanism similar to that of a standard Imperial Emnat suit.
